notes: `if cfgServer.javaFlavor.category == .modded, let mc = cfgServer.minecraftVersion, let loader = cfgServer.loaderVersion { recordLoaderVersion(...) }` (line 383-386) -- all three conditions are required; a standard-category flavor (Paper, Purpur, Vanilla) never calls this even though `resolvedVersion` is always set for it, because `category == .modded` alone gates it. `loaderVersion` is also `nil` for download-and-go flavors other than Fabric (`result.loaderVersion`, line 285), so a modded flavor with no loader version resolved (shouldn't happen in practice for NeoForge/Forge, which always set it) would also skip the call.
